On September 20, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’s (DPRK) General Missile Bureau “successfully conducted a test of the latest weaponry of critical importance to the development of weapons systems technology.”
The test involved the Hwasongpho-11Ma-1 hypersonic missile system, a new modification of the already known Hwasongpho-11Ma, which uses the Hwasong-11Ma missile.
The program has progressed from various experimental missiles to several systems that have been introduced into service, with some even participating in military exercises in 2026.
The new Hwasongpho-11Ma-1 differs from its predecessor not only in the missile itself, but also in its new launcher.
